summary: F22 to F24 and ADV-15/17/18/19 are closed for the shipped content. The 15 blog predicates and two discovery cases remain; both contrast tests pass; all five gradient properties are asserted. One nonblocking test-fixture edge remains for symlinked Markdown files.
nonblocking_findings: F25 [Nit] review-a: blog.ts:83–85 discovers posts by the .md filename suffix, while fixtures/blog-posts-loader.ts:61 includes only Dirent.isFile() entries. A symlinked .md post can therefore be discovered by production but omitted by test validation. No current blog post is a symlink, so this does not affect the shipped pages or their contrast results.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD returned a0b8e18e8f0e4529dca74b3a29b8c7741a4bd388, matching role_base_sha and audited_head_sha.

F22 is closed for current Markdown posts: blog.ts:79–86 uses a case-sensitive .md suffix on directory entries; blog-posts-loader.ts:47–65 now enumerates dotfiles and regular files, and loadAllPosts at lines 73–90 parses the same lowercase .md suffix. blog-posts-loader-dotfile.test.ts:29–43 proves a dot-prefixed .md file is listed and parsed.

The merged blog validation at blog-posts-validation.test.ts:53–240 still has 15 rule cases and two discovery cases. Compared with 257a6b0cd^, the same per-post predicates are aggregated across the loaded posts; the extension and discovery checks now use the shared suffix predicate.

The shipped test run passes blog validation and the dotfile probe. Current posts include .md files and -segments.json companions; only .md files are parsed, while the extension predicate ignores the JSON companions.

F23 and ADV-15/17/18/19 are closed: contrast.ts:67–110 resolves custom properties through element and ancestor values, and throws when a --color-* override cannot be trusted. Lines 273–347 scan current document stylesheets, ancestors, and nested grouping rules; unresolved selectors and unreadable stylesheets fail closed.

The 16 contrast helper tests include element and ancestor overrides, unresolved custom properties, injected style rules, ancestor rules, and an @media rule. Both R2 contrast tests pass on the contact and pricing pages, so the guard does not throw on shipped pages.

F24 is closed: hero-section.test.tsx:9–31 lists every expected gradient property and both default and custom stops. Lines 78–103 compare all five properties, including position, from, via, to, and background-image, with compiled stylesheet values.

The targeted Vitest run passed 9 files and 55 tests, including the blog loader, blog validation, contrast fixture, injected-style adversarial cases, both R2 contrast tests, the hero gradient tests, and the hero text contrast test.

proof-f22.log shows a dot-prefixed invalid slug fails the slug rule and names the slug. proof-f23.log shows an unsafe local override makes the pricing contrast test fail. proof-f24.log shows a changed gradient stop fails its exact value assertion.

proof-adv15.log shows an inline token override fails closed. proof-adv17.log records four passing probe cases, 16 passing helper cases, and passing contact and pricing contrast cases. adversarial-a0b8e18.json records pass at the audited head.

The exact phase diff 8a126f612abcc258c6c6711d6ac03fa085bbcbff..a0b8e18e8f0e4529dca74b3a29b8c7741a4bd388 contains tests, test fixtures, and plan.md only. The production blog module and blog post paths have no changes.
The baseline receipt records 3175 cases. The current gate records 1408 cases and 92.01% line coverage against the 85.52% floor. The reduction is 55.65%; a 20% reduction allows at most 2540 cases.
test-strategy.md:11 says graph.db is absent and this track changes no exported product symbol. Direct reference search shows the added helper exports are consumed by tests only.
F25 is a late test-fixture finding, not a product-file wrong-result finding. Under the Measure late-finding rule, it belongs in tech debt rather than a Green remediation round.
